name: 477. Model, video, container and stored-response calls on an openai-based custom provider put each id in its path template (resource path templates) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-7020 regression, contract C12. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream. Every row is skipped otherwise. On an openai-based custom provider a request_path_overrides entry replaces the whole default path. For a call whose default path names an id the entry is a template: {model}, {video_id}, {container_id}, {file_id} or {response_id} is where that id goes. TXE-6665 did this for the batch and file calls; before this change the model, video, container and stored-response calls sent the override verbatim, so the request reached the vendor with no id. tkp_vidvendor is an openai-based custom provider that templates every one of those request types off /v1: videos under /api/v3/tasks/{video_id}, the model at /api/v3/models/{model}, containers under /api/v3/boxes/{container_id}, a file inside a container at /api/v3/items/{file_id}/in/{container_id} (the file before its container, so an id placed by position would land in the wrong segment), and stored responses under /api/v3/answers/{response_id}, with the streamed retrieve on its own template /api/v3/answers/{response_id}/events. The fixture answers only under /pp/vidvendor/api/v3 and only for those ids in those places; GET /__wire returns each call with the name of the key it carried. Rows 1 to 17: one row per templated request type (video retrieve, download, remix, delete; model retrieve; container retrieve, file create, file list, file retrieve, file content, file delete, container delete; stored response retrieve, streamed retrieve, input items, cancel, delete). Each asserts the vendor's answer came back and that exactly one call reached the vendor, on the templated path with every id in place. Row 18: writing a provider whose video_retrieve override has no {video_id} is refused with a 400 and nothing is stored. Rows 1 to 17 are tagged [NO-CONTENT]: none is an inference response the collection's shape check knows, and each row asserts its own body. Run the whole folder in order.
